run_CPM_hand_pose_training: run the CPM network training script for hand pose estimation with PAF on multi-GPU
build_CPM_network: build a CPM network with 22 output channels and 20 PAFs for 3D hand pose estimation
create_multi_dataset_pipeline: create a combined data pipeline from DomeReader, RHDReader, and TsimonDBReader for hand training
configure_LearningRateScheduler: configure a learning rate scheduler with step decay from 1e-4 to 1e-5 at iteration 80000
compute_PAF_loss: compute the PAF loss using normalized vector fields with masking for valid hand joints
